chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Part of a man's happiness is that his daughter does not menstruate in his house."

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man; the father in this context

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say is part of a man's happiness regarding his daughter?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a statement from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning what is counted among a man's worldly happiness. It relates to the daughter reaching menstruation only after leaving her father's house, indicating an early transition from the paternal home into marriage.
